lede: Louisville carries the stronger underlying team rating — +10.5 against +0.9, a 9.6-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it NC State +2.4 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Louisville winning 56% of simulations.

Data confidence on this matchup is 80% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
